aws_owned_s3_object_arns.description: AWS-owned S3 objects the host may read through the endpoint (ECR layers, Amazon Linux repositories).

az_id.description: The pinned AZ ID of the host subnet (recorded after the first plan), or null to choose from az_id_preference. Pinning keeps a change of offerings or preferences from replacing the subnet.

az_id_preference.description: Availability-zone IDs in order of preference (owner decision N5); the first that offers host_instance_type is used.

egress_model.description: Owner decision N1. Only A is implemented: public subnet, no inbound access, outbound restricted to 443 and the tunnel.

flow_log_destination_arn.description: S3 destination of the VPC flow logs (owner decision C3): the AUT-103 logs bucket and its vpc-flow prefix.

host_instance_type.description: Instance type of the host (owner decision N2); the subnet's AZ must offer it.

name_prefix.description: Prefix of every resource name, e.g. veda-stg.

tunnel_egress_cidrs.description: Cloudflare tunnel edge ranges for TCP and UDP 7844 (owner decision N8).
